Hi Samir / Marissa — thanks, happy to provide details. High-level answers and our standard process below (happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk through):

SOC 2 / Compliance
- We hold SOC 2 Type II (covering security, availability, and confidentiality) with the most recent report dated 2025-10-15. A copy is attached (redacted where necessary for public sharing).
- Regarding HIPAA: Redwood can operate as a business associate under a signed BAA. We segregate PHI access controls, logging, and provide customer-specific controls as part of our private deployments.
- GDPR: we support data processing agreements and region-specific routing; see our DPA for details.

Pen test & Vulnerability Management
- External pen tests: annual third-party engagements (most recent summary attached). We perform continuous internal scanning and monthly authenticated scans across prod.
- Scanning cadence: internal weekly scans (automated), monthly authenticated scans, quarterly external scans and annual third-party pentest.
- Vulnerability triage & SLA (remediation target from detection):
  - Critical: action/mitigation within 72 hours, patch/mitigation in 7 days when feasible
  - High: remediation target 14 calendar days
  - Medium: remediation target 30 calendar days
  - Low: remediation planned in next release cycle or 90 days
- Disclosure & report sharing: we can provide a redacted pen test report immediately under normal intake. Full, unredacted reports require an NDA and a documented justification; we also recommend a short call to review high-risk findings. Coordinated disclosure: 90-day standard window for responsible disclosure unless an earlier MOU is agreed.
- Incident response: 24x7 on-call rotation, with customer notification SLAs in our BAA/DPA for incidents involving customer data.

Contacts & artifacts
- For questionnaire intake and controlled report sharing: security@redwood.com (team triage).
- I've attached our internal vulnerability response playbook for your reviewers.

Attachments:
- vuln_response_playbook.pdf

If you need a copy of the full pen test under NDA, Marissa can route our legal/security NDA template and we can set up a secure transfer.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
